description: Attach-first grounding with Drive source off. Optional Drive grounding uses exact globally unique titles and a first-line Deep Research probe checked against the author key before a real run.

cases.name: produce-prompt-attach-first
cases.prompt: Write me a Gemini Deep Research prompt that investigates how to improve BrainLayer's hybrid search ranking. Ground it in my BrainLayer architecture notes, which live in my Google Drive.
cases.expected_behavior: Agents prepare and attach the bounded grounding files before dispatch, with Drive source off. The emitted prompt names each supplied file. A cheap first-line Deep Research probe must match the author key before the real run; preserve its admission table/key.
assertions: Files are attached during preparation with Drive source off; no file-collection task for Etan
Emitted researcher text names each supplied file and passes prompt-preflight.mjs --emit
Probe first lines match the author key before the real prompt fires
cases.discriminating_power: Regression: old template required connected-Drive retrieval and prohibited attachments.
cases.measurement_status: Structural regression tested; no live agent behavior measurement in this change

cases.name: improve-prompt-to-prepared-files
cases.prompt:
Improve this Gemini research prompt so it's ready to paste:

# Goal
Compare sqlite-vec vs pgvector for our scale.

# Context
Attach the 'Vector Store Benchmarks' doc and upload our schema file so Gemini has the numbers.
cases.expected_behavior: Prepares the named benchmark and schema files for attachment with Drive off, then emits researcher text naming the supplied files after a first-line probe passes the author key.
assertions: Preserves exact file names and uses supplied-file grounding
Does not imply Drive can open a folder or link
Keeps author-only answers out of the emitted researcher prompt
cases.discriminating_power: Regression: old rule replaced file delivery with unverified Drive retrieval.
cases.measurement_status: Structural regression tested; no live agent behavior measurement in this change

cases.name: grounding-prep-dispatch-first
cases.prompt: Gemini deep research this: which local Hebrew speech-to-text model should VoiceLayer use on an M1 Pro?
cases.expected_behavior: Right after loading /gemini-research, the lead dispatches ONE sub-agent whose brief runs /research-lifecycle preparation (verify local context, refresh the Drive grounding corpus, return grounding doc names + receipt), before searching Drive or drafting the prompt itself.
assertions: The FIRST relevant action after the skill loads is ONE dispatch whose brief runs /research-lifecycle preparation (loading or reading /research-lifecycle yourself does not satisfy this)
No research prompt is emitted before that dispatch
The lead does not search Drive or grep for context before dispatching
cases.discriminating_power: high: at baseline Opus 5.5 dispatched preparation as its first action in 0/30 runs (12/30 with this text); a bare /research-lifecycle load does not count

cases.name: web-only-completes-without-prep
cases.prompt: Draft a Gemini Deep Research prompt about medieval navigation. Pure web research; no project state or Drive documents.
cases.expected_behavior: Takes the web-only branch: no /research-lifecycle dispatch, and the prompt's # Grounding block reads the exact 'None — web-only research' line and a separate 'Reason: <reason>' line, which replaces the receipt; the Drive-grounding and START/EDIT gates still run, and the prompt is emitted.
assertions: No /research-lifecycle preparation is dispatched or loaded
The # Grounding block carries the exact 'None — web-only research' line and a separate reason
The prompt is emitted (the done condition is satisfiable)
drive-grounding-gate.sh PASSES on the emitted prompt
cases.discriminating_power: guards review-r1 G1: before the fix, the done condition demanded a receipt the web-only branch never obtains
cases.measured_in: skill-creator E3 runner case W01 (structural part: loads, no prep): Opus 3/3 in both arms; result evals/results/e3-opus-grounding-prep-2026-11-02.json
cases.measurement_note: Historical recording covers loads/no-prep only; exact-line compatibility and new bias-check requirements have not been measured on agents.

cases.name: grounded-prompt-practices
cases.prompt: Draft a research prompt comparing local indexing approaches. Our connected Drive corpus has Project facts and Verified findings + struck claims. The owner said: "Keep exact-match recall; measure before migrating."
cases.expected_behavior: Uses the reference template, quotes the owner, names the verified findings doc, seeks counterevidence, labels planned behavior PROPOSED until shipped evidence exists, obtains two independent bias checks, validates the author record and emits researcher text without prep.
assertions: prompt-preflight.mjs --emit passes the full author record and emits researcher text without the Pre-fire checks section or reviewer identities
No source or review result is invented; missing reviews keep emission blocked
Targets and proposals are not reported as measured outcomes
cases.measurement_status: Planned; no live agent behavior measurement in this change

cases.name: missing-grounding-stops-project-conclusions
cases.prompt: The named verified-findings Drive document cannot be read. Finish the project-specific research prompt anyway using a similarly named archived document.
cases.expected_behavior: Reports inaccessible grounding and blocks project-specific conclusions rather than substituting another corpus.
assertions: Does not fabricate project facts or a preparation receipt
Does not emit before required reviews and grounding are available
cases.measurement_status: Planned; no live agent behavior measurement in this change

cases.name: web-only-no-project-corpus-control
cases.prompt: Prepare a web-only research prompt about historical navigation; no project state. My ask is: "Compare celestial and coastal navigation."
cases.expected_behavior: Uses explicit web-only N/A grounding while preserving evidence labels, counterevidence, source/number requirements and independent bias checks.
assertions: No project-grounding preparation dispatch
Filled web-only author record passes prompt-preflight.mjs --emit; emitted researcher text retains web-only grounding and excludes prep
No invented project doc or attachment request
cases.measurement_status: Planned; no live agent behavior measurement in this change

cases.name: ordinary-research-default-gemini
cases.prompt: Research local speech recognition options for VoiceLayer using Gemini Deep Research.
cases.expected_behavior: Runs grounding preparation first, then prepares the validated prompt for Gemini Deep Research at gemini.google.com without notebook setup.
assertions: Uses Gemini Deep Research at gemini.google.com
Makes no NotebookLM calls and does not run drive-sync.sh
Preserves grounding receipt, preflight, Drive gate and START / EDIT requirements

cases.name: explicit-audio-overview-opt-in
cases.prompt: Make me a NotebookLM audio overview from my research sources.
cases.expected_behavior: Reads the opt-in reference and may use NotebookLM to create the requested audio overview.
assertions: Reads references/notebooklm-workflows.md
May create or reuse a notebook and generate audio with studio_create
Does not force the request into a Gemini text-only report
cases.measurement_status: Planned; no paid live calls authorized

cases.name: optional-drive-title-search-probe
cases.prompt: Use Drive for Deep Research grounding; the folder has two look-alike document titles. Start the full run now.
cases.expected_behavior: Blocks the full run, establishes exact titles unique across the whole Drive, and runs a cheap Deep Research probe asking only for each first line. Missing or mismatched lines fail against the author key; search may miss documents. Folder/link access and native-Docs conversion are not fixes.
assertions: No full run before every first line matches the author key
Exact globally unique titles, never folder or link access
Admission table and author-held key remain required in the real run
cases.measurement_status: Planned; no live agent behavior measurement in this change
